title: Circuit symbols card
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Working scientifically, revision through enquiry (Revolution)
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 31 (Circuit symbols card (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 31: Circuits and symbols revisited. To understand how to build and draw a complete circuit using standard symbols

questions.q: Draw a circuit with one cell, one bulb and an open switch. Will the bulb light?
questions.a: No: the open switch makes a gap
questions.model: Draw the cell, then a wire to the bulb, then to the switch, then back. The switch is open: a gap. No complete loop, so no light.

questions.a: Everyone can read them; quicker than drawing pictures

questions.q: Build a circuit with a cell, bulb and switch using the kit (or the simulator), then draw it with symbols. Repeat with a buzzer.
questions.a: Two correct symbol diagrams; both work when the switch is closed
questions.model: Teacher builds the cell-bulb-switch circuit on camera and draws it with symbols.

questions.q: Find and explain the fault in each of the three diagrams on the sheet.
questions.a: Gap in wire; open switch; no cell

questions.q: Draw a circuit where one switch controls two bulbs.
questions.a: Two bulbs and one switch in a single loop

questions.q: A circle with a cross is a...
Big question: why might a torch not work?
questions.a: The circuit is incomplete: flat cell, broken bulb, gap or wrong-way cell.
